destinations.name: Keokradong Trek
destinations.description: A multi-day trek through the Bandarban hill country to one of Bangladesh's best-known mountain summits. Plan with a registered local guide and confirm current access requirements before departure.
destinations.safetyNotes: Travel with a registered local guide, check weather and access conditions, and carry sufficient water.
destinations.permissionNote: Confirm current local administration and security permissions before travel.

destinations.name: Cox's Bazar Beach
destinations.description: A coastal getaway along the Bay of Bengal with a long sandy beach, local seafood, and nearby viewpoints. Check local weather and sea conditions before swimming or boating.
destinations.safetyNotes: Follow beach safety flags and local lifeguard guidance; avoid swimming during rough conditions.
